column1: # Perl corpus: packages. Format and regeneration: crates/builtins/src/perl/tests.rs.

column2: sub f { package Mars; return __PACKAGE__ } print f(),'|',__PACKAGE__,"\n";
package Mars; sub f {5} package Earth; print Mars::f(),"\n";
package Mars; our $x=4; package Earth; our $x=9; print "$Mars::x|$Earth::x\n";
package Mars; sub foo {42} my $f=*{$Mars::{foo}}{CODE}; print $f->(),"\n";
